subject: math
cluster: Understand congruence and similarity using physical models, transparencies, or geometry software
intro: Each problem uses a single angle fact: the angles of a triangle add to $180^\circ$, an exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles, or the angle pairs formed when a transversal crosses parallel lines. Substitute the given whole-number measures into one relationship and compute. No variables are needed.

items.prompt: Two angles of a triangle measure $50^\circ$ and $60^\circ$. Find the measure of the third angle.

steps: The interior angles of a triangle sum to $180^\circ$.

items.prompt: A triangle has angles of $90^\circ$ and $35^\circ$. Find the measure of the third angle.

steps: The interior angles of a triangle sum to $180^\circ$.

items.prompt: Two angles of a triangle measure $47^\circ$ and $68^\circ$. Find the measure of the third angle.

steps: The interior angles of a triangle sum to $180^\circ$.

items.prompt: An equilateral triangle has all three angles equal. Find the measure of each angle.

steps: The interior angles of a triangle sum to $180^\circ$.
All three angles are equal, so divide the total by $3$: $\frac{180^\circ}{3}$.

items.prompt: In a triangle, the two remote interior angles measure $52^\circ$ and $71^\circ$. Find the measure of the exterior angle adjacent to the third vertex.

steps: By the exterior-angle theorem, an exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.
Add the two remote interior angles: $52^\circ + 71^\circ$.

items.prompt: The two remote interior angles of a triangle measure $40^\circ$ and $35^\circ$. Find the measure of the exterior angle at the third vertex.

steps: By the exterior-angle theorem, an exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.

items.prompt: Lines $\ell$ and $m$ are parallel and cut by a transversal. One angle measures $113^\circ$. Find the measure of its alternate interior angle.

steps: When parallel lines are cut by a transversal, alternate interior angles are congruent.
So the alternate interior angle equals the given angle.

items.prompt: Lines $\ell$ and $m$ are parallel and cut by a transversal. One angle measures $113^\circ$. Find the measure of its co-interior (same-side interior) angle.

steps: When parallel lines are cut by a transversal, co-interior (same-side interior) angles are supplementary, so they sum to $180^\circ$.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. A pair of corresponding angles is formed, and one of them measures $74^\circ$. Find the measure of the other corresponding angle.

steps: When parallel lines are cut by a transversal, corresponding angles are congruent.
So the other corresponding angle equals the given angle.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One angle measures $128^\circ$. Find the measure of its alternate exterior angle.

steps: When parallel lines are cut by a transversal, alternate exterior angles are congruent.
So the alternate exterior angle equals the given angle.

items.prompt: Two angles of a triangle measure $25^\circ$ and $90^\circ$. Find the measure of the third angle.

steps: The interior angles of a triangle sum to $180^\circ$.

items.prompt: Triangle $ABC$ has angles $40^\circ$, $75^\circ$, and $65^\circ$. Triangle $DEF$ also has two angles measuring $40^\circ$ and $75^\circ$. By the angle-angle (AA) criterion, are the two triangles similar? Answer yes or no.
items.answer: Yes, the triangles are similar by AA.

steps: The AA criterion says two triangles are similar if two pairs of their angles are congruent.
Both triangles have an angle of $40^\circ$ and an angle of $75^\circ$.
That is two pairs of congruent angles, which is enough for AA similarity.
So the triangles are similar by AA.

items.prompt: Triangle $PQR$ has two angles measuring $30^\circ$ and $80^\circ$. Triangle $STU$ has two angles measuring $30^\circ$ and $80^\circ$. By the angle-angle (AA) criterion, are the two triangles similar? Answer yes or no.
items.answer: Yes, the triangles are similar by AA.

steps: The AA criterion says two triangles are similar if two pairs of angles are congruent.
Both triangles share an angle of $30^\circ$ and an angle of $80^\circ$.
Two pairs of congruent angles satisfy AA.
So the triangles are similar by AA.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One angle measures $95^\circ$. Find the measure of its co-interior (same-side interior) angle.

steps: When parallel lines are cut by a transversal, co-interior (same-side interior) angles are supplementary, so they sum to $180^\circ$.

items.prompt: The two remote interior angles of a triangle measure $63^\circ$ and $48^\circ$. Find the measure of the exterior angle at the third vertex.

steps: By the exterior-angle theorem, an exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.
